00077 void UGenOutput::useExternalOutput(UGenOutput* externalOutputToUse)
00078 {
00079  if(externalOutputToUse == 0)
00080  {
00081   float value = 0.f;
00082   
00083   if(block)
00084    value = block[blockSize-1];
00085   
00086   usingExternalOutput = false;
00087   blockSize = UGen::getEstimatedBlockSize();
00088   allocatedBlockSize = blockSize;
00089   block = new float[blockSize];
00090   externalOutput = 0;
00091   
00092   initValue(value);
00093  }
00094  else
00095  {
00096   float value = 0.f;
00097   
00098   if(block)
00099    value = block[blockSize-1];
00100   
00101   if(usingExternalOutput == false)
00102    delete [] block;
00103   
00104   usingExternalOutput = true;
00105   block = externalOutputToUse->block;
00106   blockSize = externalOutputToUse->blockSize;
00107   allocatedBlockSize = 0;
00108   externalOutput = externalOutputToUse;
00109   
00110   initValue(value);
00111  }
00112 }

00234 float* UGenInternal::processBlockInternal(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00235 {
00236  if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00237  {
00238   processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00239   
00240   if(isScheduledForDeletion == false && shouldDelete == true)
00241   {
00242    isScheduledForDeletion = true;
00243    blockIDtoBeDeletedAfter = blockID;
00244   }
00245   
00246   lastBlockID = blockID;
00247  }
00248  
00249  return uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00250 }

00296 int UGenInternal::findMaxInputChannels() const throw()
00297 {
00298  int numChannels = 0;
00299  
00300  for(int i = 0; i < numInputs_; i++)
00301  {
00302   int inputChannels = inputs[i].getNumChannels();
00303   if(inputChannels > numChannels)
00304    numChannels = inputChannels;
00305  }
00306  
00307  return numChannels;
00308 }

00344 UGenInternal* UGenInternal::getInput(const int inputIndex, const int channel) throw()
00345 {
00346  ugen_assert(channel >= 0);
00347  
00348  if(inputIndex < 0 || inputIndex >= numInputs_) 
00349  {
00350   ugen_assertfalse;
00351   return 0;
00352  }
00353  
00354  UGen& input = inputs[inputIndex];
00355  return input.getInternalUGen(channel % input.getNumChannels());

00399 void ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::deleteIfOnlyMutualReferencesRemain() throw()
00400 {
00401  if(getRefCount() > numProxies_) return; 
00402  
00403  for(int i = 1 ; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00404  {
00405   if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() > 1) return;
00406  }
00407  
00408  for(int i = 1 ; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00409  {
00410   UGen::getDeleter()->deleteInternal(proxies[i]);
00411  }
00412  
00413  active = false;
00414  UGen::getDeleter()->deleteInternal(this);
00415 }
00416 
00417 UGenInternal* ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::getProxy(const int index) throw()
00418 {
00419  // indices are between 0 and numProxies_ (0 is the owner)
00420  if(index < 0 || index > numProxies_) 
00421  {
00422   ugen_assertfalse;
00423   return 0;
00424  }
00425  
00426  proxies[index]->incrementRefCount();
00427  return proxies[index];
00428 }

00430 void ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::prepareForBlockInternal(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID) throw()
00431 {
00432  ugen_assert(actualBlockSize > 0);
00433  
00434  if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00435  {
00436   UGenInternal::prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00437   
00438   for(int i = 1; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00439   {
00440    // if the refCount is only 1 its block won't get 
00441    // prepared by the normal dsp call chain, check for <=1 just in case
00442    if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() <= 1)
00443     proxies[i]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00444   } 
00445  }
00446 }

00449 float* ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::processBlockInternal(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00450 {
00451  if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00452  {
00453   for(int i = 1; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00454   {
00455    // if the refCount is only 1 its block won't get 
00456    // prepared by the normal dsp call chain, check for <=1 just in case
00457    if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() <= 1)
00458     proxies[i]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00459   }
00460 
00461   UGenInternal::processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00462  }
00463  
00464  return uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00465 }
